title: Fix Map Building highlight alignment
description:
Map workspace sheets were being laid out at ~2.8× crop size, then clamped back down to native size without keeping the display scale. PDF media and highlight overlays no longer shared the same box, so lines looked far off on Map Building even when they were correct in the PDF Viewer.

This release keeps map page display scale intact, restores clamped map pages on load, and rebuilds map highlight geometry from the viewer mirror copies using normalized coords.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building / PDF Viewer on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync after deploy. Open the map workspace once so projections rebuild; re-draw only if a line has no viewer mirror.
changeLog: Keep Map Building page display scale (stop clamping sheets back to native crop size).
Restore already-clamped map pages and rebuild highlight overlays from viewer mirrors.
PDF Viewer zoom + viewer→map mirror still use nrx as the source of truth.
